scope: PHASE 6 pixel track batch B-p1 (docs/requirements/PHASE6_PIXEL_ASSET_SPEC.md §5): programmatic fix of the floating combat text (FCT) render chain. Root cause verified in spec §3.1.3: FloatingDamage.tscn:7 parent Node2D scale=Vector2(0.5,0.5) compresses the MainTheme 18px rsans vector font to an effective 9px, which reads as a 'monogram pixel font'; monogram-extended.ttf / stack_pixel.ttf are orphan fonts with zero references in 03_raw/04_recovered and are NOT touched. Fix: scale -> Vector2(1,1) + explicit Label DynamicFont (rsans.ttf size=18, outline_size=1, outline_color=Color(0,0,0,1), mirroring MainTheme default font id=5) so FCT renders at 18px logical coordinates (within spec 16-18px), decoupled from theme default changes. Zero new pack paths (roundtrip 3744 safe). No script changes: FloatingDamage.gd crit rect_scale x2 tween left as-is per spec (crit params await designer decision; the optional CODE_PATCH is deliberately NOT exercised). No font file replacement.

entities.expected_runtime_effect: the FloatingDamageText parent Node2D scale changes from Vector2(0.5,0.5) to Vector2(1,1); the Label child (theme=MainTheme, 18px default font) renders at full 18px logical coordinates instead of effective 9px; shared by all FCT usages (damage numbers / XP / hints)

the Label gains an explicit DynamicFont sub-resource (rsans.ttf, size=18, outline_size=1, outline_color=Color(0,0,0,1), identical to MainTheme default font id=5) so FCT font size is explicit in the scene and no longer inherited from the theme default; effective logical size 18px
